definition: סְאָה noun feminine (see below ) se'ah , a measure of flour, grain, etc. (√ unknown; perhaps foreign word; Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic סְאָה , סָאתָא , , , (Greek σάτον , Lewy Fremdwörter 116 f )); — absolute סְאָהֿ 2Kgs 7:1 ; 2Kgs 7:16 , וּסֳאָהֿ v 2Kgs 7:18 ( Baer Ginsb compare Ges «GKC:10h»§ 10h ); dual סָאתַיִם 1Kgs 18:32 + 3 t.; plural סְאִים Gen 18:6 ; 1Sam 25:18 — always with appositive of thing measured, Gen 18:6 ( J ), 1Sam 25:18 ; 1Kgs 18:32 ; 2Kgs 7:1 (twice in verse); 2Kgs 7:16 (twice in verse); 2Kgs 7:18 (twice in verse) (where apparently masculine, perhaps after analogy of other measures of capacity, הִין , תֹמֶר , כֹּר , etc., Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 95 ); — סַאסְּאָה Isa 27:8 see סאסא . — On size of se'ah = 1/3 ephah, = 12.148 litres (= 10.696 qts.), see Now Archaeology i. 203 Benz Archaeology 183 .
